newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares rise with Wall St ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares rise with Wall St ahead of holiday.

text.p: 1625 GMT - Shares closed firmer overall ahead of Friday's holiday as Wall Street gained but a number of leading blue chips were weaker. Traders said the performance on Monday would depend on how London and New York traded on Friday.
*Traders said that the fact the July U.S. inflation figure came in as predicted calmed immediate concerns about a possible U.S. rate rise on August 19.
*The .PSI20 index closed 0.71 percent higher at 8,270.57. Overall trade was a mere 7.8 billion escudos.

*Telecel was the session's best performer amongst the blue chips, with its 3.94 percent gain to 14,395 escudos being attributed to a lack of available paper. This enabled some funds to "push" the price, traders said.
*EDP also gained, recovering to 3,200 escudos, up 0.47 percent on the day.
